job._split_note: Butina (scaffold) split groups molecules by chemical scaffold so train/valid/test sets contain different scaffolds. This produces a more challenging and realistic evaluation than random splitting for drug-like molecules.
job._encoding_note: Kekulize (use_aromatic_bonds=false) is recommended: the model cannot generate an invalid aromatic system. Aromatic bonds add a 4th bond type and require the model to learn valid aromaticity rules.
job._perf_note: batch_size=1000 subgraphs per preprocessing group; block_size=100000 subgraphs cached in RAM per training block.
